+## Core invariants, 2026-11-10
+
+CPU checks now cover strictly newer turn generations, replacement incarnations,
+accepted-event replay after expiry in both advice modes, store-owned mutations,
+constructor validation and bounded retention accounting. Replay preserves its
+original ready-prefix measurement even if native readiness changes. Fixed settings
+and labels for absent features were removed. Portable acceptance passed 24 tests;
+all 13 pinned runtime CPU tests passed, followed by a focused scheduler rerun.
+This adds no GPU or performance qualification.
+[Checks and limits](evidence/core-fixes-20261110.md). A concurrent type-check
+cache collision was repaired with separate caches;
+[verification repair](evidence/core-fixes-cache-repair-20261110.md).
+

 Advice requires the exact server observation timestamp and identity, a live
-deadline and the matching engine clock. An exact replay returns its original
-acknowledgement without another mutation; changed content for an existing event
-refuses. Event capacity refuses further new events. Session capacity retires the
-least recently active session and counts the retirement. A new registration gets a
+deadline and the matching engine clock. An exact replay of an accepted event
+returns its original decision, count and
+ready-prefix measurement even after its deadline, without another cache mutation.
+The replay flag becomes true and newly refreshed count becomes zero. This also
+applies with advice disabled. A foreign engine clock still refuses. Changed
+content for an existing event refuses. Event capacity refuses further new events.
+Session capacity retires the least recently active session and counts the retirement. A new registration gets a
 new server timestamp, which invalidates older hints. Reset clears observations and
 replay state.
 
+The observation store owns all session, replay, recency and accounting mutations.
+Callers receive immutable observation snapshots and typed registration/advice
+results. Constructors enforce the same identity, integer and clock bounds as
+schema parsers, including direct construction and dataclass replacement.
+
+The accounting budget charges UTF-8 identity/namespace bytes at four times their
+size, 128 bytes plus payload per block key and 1024 bytes per observation.
+Each accepted event charges 1024 bytes plus four times its serialized hint size.
+It bounds retained payload and object counts; it is not a measurement or strict
+limit of process resident memory. Observations permit at most one million keys,
+each at most 256 bytes. Oversized registrations refuse without replacing existing
+state. Capacity pressure retires least recently active sessions until registration
+fits; events refuse before any ARC mutation if their charge would exceed the
+budget. Replacement, retirement and reset release their charges. Limits and
+accounting charges live in `limits.py`.

+# Core invariants, 2026-11-10
+
+## Scope
+
+CPU-only repair of the approved core fixes in the agent environment review.
+No GPU, serving performance or answer-quality claim. The external pinned runtime
+was read only; no installation or runtime changes were made.
+
+## Behavior exercised
+
+- Equal and older generations refuse; another incarnation replaces the session.
+- Accepted enabled and disabled events replay after deadline without refreshing.
+- Replay retains its original ready-prefix measurement after native readiness changes.
+- Observation readers cannot mutate the store's snapshot.
+- Direct constructors and dataclass replacement reject invalid identities,
+  Booleans as integer limits, invalid clocks and unbounded block-key payloads.
+- Registration and event admission respect the retention accounting budget.
+  Oversized registrations preserve state; event refusal precedes cache mutation;
+  retirement and reset release charges.
+- Settings reject the removed fixed store threshold and eviction policy.
+  Mechanism reporting keeps CPU capacity and advice enablement.
+
+## Verification
+
+Portable acceptance: 24 CPU tests passed; 9 groups passed, 2 groups skipped,
+0 failures. Native builds and the recorded runtime lane were skipped as designed.
+
+Command: `uv run --locked python tools/check.py`.
+
+Pinned runtime CPU integration: all 13 tests passed. A subsequent focused rerun
+of the 7 scheduler tests covered the final expired-replay/readiness assertions.
+These use fake transfer handlers and do not exercise CUDA workers.
+
+Command: `uv run --locked python tools/check.py --runtime-python /home/philip/.local/share/venvs/wait-hint-offload/bin/python --test tests/runtime`.
+Focused rerun uses `--test tests/runtime/test_scheduler.py`.
+
+Strict runtime typing passed for all 13 adapter/runtime-test source files using
+the external runtime as the import environment. The final scheduler assertions
+were also checked before commit.
+
+No verifier attempt receipt was created: the runtime commands were explicitly
+partial checks. Rule proofs were not rerun because rules and tooling did not
+change. The 64 MiB default is a bounded retention accounting budget, not a measured
+process resident-memory ceiling.

+# Verification cache repair, 2026-11-10
+
+The final documentation-only amend initially failed its acceptance hook because
+portable mypy and runtime mypy shared a cache while resolving different pytest
+versions. The assertion named the absent
+`_pytest.warning_types.PytestRemovedIn10Warning`.
+
+The preceding full portable acceptance had passed; the concurrent final strict
+runtime rerun also completed successfully for all 13 files. A fresh, separate
+portable cache repaired acceptance without changing checks or adding exceptions.
+The final hook passed using the repaired portable cache. Runtime and portable
+cache contents were retained separately under the ignored mypy cache directory.
+
+This is a verification scheduling/cache failure, not an extra product result.
+The runtime test results and scope are in
+[the core-fixes evidence](core-fixes-20261110.md).
